description:
QuietPass generates new random passwords directly in Safari. Set your requirements once, then open the extension whenever you need another password.

YOUR PASSWORD RULES
• Choose a length from 8 to 64 characters.
• Select simple, standard or complex character sets.
• Enable special characters separately.
• Add two hyphens to divide a password into three balanced groups. Separators count toward the total length.

READY WHEN YOU OPEN IT
Each opening produces one main password and five independently generated alternatives. Copy any password or insert it into the editable field you selected on the current page. Forms are not submitted. Your generation preferences are saved automatically.

LOCAL HISTORY
Only passwords you successfully copy or insert are added to history. History is stored locally in the macOS Keychain, separately for each Safari profile. Choose 1, 7, 30 or 90 days of retention, or turn saving off. The default is 7 days. Expired entries are removed the next time history is accessed. You can clear history with confirmation.

QuietPass works without an account or a server and includes no advertising or tracking SDKs. History is not synced through iCloud. In private windows, generation and copying are available; history and insertion are disabled.

Requires macOS 15 or later and Safari 18 or later. Enable QuietPass in Safari Settings → Extensions. The containing app does not need to remain running.
promotionalText: New passwords directly in Safari, saved generation preferences and local history with a retention period you choose.
